actions: Require new-Pod-specific readiness and version evidence.
Do not collapse rollout success into Service availability.
analysis: During a rolling update an old Ready Pod can keep the Service available while the new Pod is not yet proven; endpoints, image digest, and /version must be verified.
cautions: Do not use Service 200 responses alone as new-version proof.
excerpt: 发现并修复：Service port-forward 随旧 Pod 退出；Windows 复制的恢复脚本缺少执行位；Shell 同一 local 声明引用未赋值变量；滚动发布时旧 Pod Ready 不能证明新版本完成。Alloy 配置先通过自身 validate，再检查实际日志流。
rollback: Roll back through Git desired state and verify the resulting image and /version.
title: 旧 Pod Ready 不能证明新版本完成
